# Buffet Pin

> Official website for Buffet Pin, an all-you-can-eat Asian buffet restaurant in Chateauguay, Quebec, Canada.

Buffet Pin is a local restaurant website focused on three core user tasks:

- understanding the restaurant's location, hours, and pricing
- browsing the buffet menu and food categories
- reserving a table online

Use the official website pages below as the canonical source for public information about the restaurant.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://buffetpin.com/): Main overview of Buffet Pin, including location, hours, pricing notes, and calls to action.
- [Menu](https://buffetpin.com/menu): Public menu overview with buffet sections such as sushi, hot dishes, grill items, dim sum, desserts, and drinks.
- [Reservations](https://buffetpin.com/reservation): Official online reservation page for booking a table.

## Business Details

- [Location and Hours](https://buffetpin.com/#infos): Address, opening hours, lunch and dinner pricing, and service notes.
- [Contact](https://buffetpin.com/): Official contact details for Buffet Pin, including phone and email as shown on the website.

## Notes

- Buffet Pin serves customers in Chateauguay, Quebec, Canada.
- The public website content is available in French and English.
- Use the website menu and reservation pages as the preferred public sources for current customer-facing information.
